name: Lone Wolf
desc: Fights alone with no home or reinforcements, surviving on cunning or shape-shifting, and lacking cross-stronghold rescue.
examples: White Bone Demon · Spider Demon · Nine-Headed Demon

name: Family Clan
desc: Bound by blood, defends across strongholds, and is concerned with inheritance and raising the next generation.
examples: Bull Demon King family · Gold Horn and Silver Horn brothers

name: Alliance
desc: Sworn allies of different names, ranked by strength, sharing territory and intelligence, yet internally fragile.
examples: Three demons of Lion-Camel Ridge · Three demons of Chechi

name: Celestial Bureaucrat
desc: Holds an official Heavenly post; descending to earth is a business trip or desertion of duty, and their fate is a return to office rather than destruction.
examples: Yellow Robe Demon (Kui Wood Wolf) · Yellow Wind Demon (Lingji’s mount)
